goal.vi: Mở đầu cuộc họp, mời mọi người phát biểu, giữ đúng giờ và chốt ai làm gì.
goal.en: Open a meeting, invite people to speak, keep to time and sum up who does what.

lines: Okay, let's get started. Thanks, everyone, for coming.
Today we'll discuss the budget and agree on next steps. Sam, I'd like to hear from you first.
Sure. I think we should spend more on ads. Also, what about the new office chairs?
Good idea, but let's park the chairs for now and come back to them later.
We're running short on time, so let's move on. Are we all on the same page about ads?
Great. To wrap up, Sam will send the new numbers by Friday.

phrases.say: Let's get started. Thanks, everyone, for coming.
phrases.not: We start now. Thank you for your coming.

mean.vi: Mở đầu cuộc họp thân thiện
mean.en: Open a meeting in a friendly way

phrases.say: Today we'll discuss the budget and agree on next steps.
phrases.not: Today we will discuss about the budget.

mean.vi: Nói mục tiêu của cuộc họp
mean.en: Say the goal of the meeting

phrases.say: Sam, I'd like to hear from you on this.

why.vi: Câu này mời người khác nói một cách thân thiện, không ép.
why.en: This invites someone to speak in a friendly way.

phrases.say: Let's park that for now and come back to it later.
phrases.not: This is not important, stop talking.

mean.vi: Tạm gác một chủ đề để giữ đúng giờ
mean.en: Put a topic aside to stay on time

why.vi: "Park" một ý giúp giữ đúng giờ mà không làm ai mất lòng.
why.en: "Park" an idea to save time without being rude.

phrases.say: We're running short on time, so let's move on.

mean.vi: Chuyển sang nội dung khác khi gần hết giờ
mean.en: Go to the next topic when time is short

why.vi: Nói lý do chuyển ý để không ai thấy bị cắt lời.
why.en: Give the reason, so nobody feels cut off.

phrases.say: Are we all on the same page?

mean.vi: Kiểm tra mọi người đã thống nhất chưa

why.vi: Kiểm tra sự đồng thuận mà không giống giáo viên hỏi bài.
why.en: Checks agreement without sounding like a teacher.

phrases.say: To wrap up, Lee will send the report by Friday.
phrases.not: For finish, Lee sends report Friday.

mean.vi: Tóm tắt và chốt việc cần làm
mean.en: Sum up and agree on tasks

why.vi: Kết thúc bằng ai làm gì, trước khi nào.
why.en: End with who does what, and by when.

ai.name: Sam
ai.role: a team member in a weekly meeting
ai.persona: friendly, talks a lot and likes new ideas

roleplay.you: You lead the meeting. Open it, invite your coworker to speak, put one topic aside, check everyone agrees and sum up.
